steps.title: What Scenic Avatar does
steps.body: Simple tag-to-image avatar engine using portable Scenic Packs. The overview introduces this area without opening its other sections.

steps.title: Read pack availability
steps.body: In Overview, read Pack availability. This tells whether a usable Scenic Pack is present for the engine. If no pack is available, the pack controls have nothing to act on yet; look for packs before blaming rendering. This page does not switch avatar providers for you.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Refresh and select a pack
steps.body: Refresh packs reloads the available list, then Scenic pack selects which pack the engine uses. Choose a pack that availability reports as usable. Selection prepares this engine; whether the avatar appears still depends on Scenic Avatar being the current avatar engine elsewhere.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Inspect preview and pack contents
steps.body: Selected pack preview shows the chosen pack visually and Pack contents lists what it includes. Use both before expecting specific tags to map to images. If a tag renders unexpectedly, compare it with Pack contents; a missing entry is a pack gap, not necessarily a configuration error.
